conditions: You can have only one active adversary. Clear or convert any existing Lich, Sister, or Coda before starting.
The final showdown is locked behind Saturn Proxima; check the Railjack requirements before investing in a Lich.

groups.place: KUVA SIPHON OR KUVA FLOOD, ANY
groups.activity: earn and crack Requiem Eterna Relics

rows.label: Oull
rows.note: wildcard Requiem; optional but very strong

conditions: Kuva Floods guarantee a Requiem Eterna Relic; Kuva Siphons have a 50% chance. Crack Eterna at a Kuva Fortress fissure for one of the eight Requiem mods.
Each Requiem has three charges. Only a successful Lich kill consumes a charge, but plan to replace about one mod per Lich vanquished.
Palladino sells retired Requiem I-IV relics for 10 Riven Slivers each, capped at 10 weekly. Requiem mods themselves are tradeable.
bonuses: Oull substitutes for any Requiem and has three charges. Two Oulls cannot be equipped in the same sequence.

disclosures.title: stock mods before starting
disclosures.body: A new Lich cannot be removed until its three-Requiem sequence is solved. Bring a usable mod pool first so the tax does not trap you while farming your first set.

groups.activity: Capture; spawn and inspect Kuva Larvlings

rows.label: Kuva Nukor Larvling
rows.note: weapon preview must say Kuva Nukor
rows.alt: buy a converted Kuva Nukor Lich from another player

rows.label: Magnetic progenitor
rows.note: Mercy with Mag, Mesa, Cyte-09, or another Magnetic frame
rows.alt: Elemental Vice can change it at rank 40

conditions: After the yellow screen flash, kill 10 enemies within 60 seconds to spawn the Larvling; add 10 required kills for each extra squadmate. Stand within 3 m of it to preview the weapon before Mercy.
If the preview is not Kuva Nukor, leave it alive and complete the mission. The shown weapon leaves the candidate pool until it cycles; aborting does not reject it.
The Warframe that performs the Mercy fixes the bonus element. Magnetic is the usual choice for the Nukor's status-primer role; its native element is Radiation.
bonuses: Cassini Capture is the usual fast solo loop. Telesto Exterminate and Adaro Exterminate are alternatives.

disclosures.title: never abort a rejected Larvling
disclosures.body: Finishing without Mercy is the only way to narrow the weapon pool and force a Nukor. Accepting any Larvling clears the whole reject list, so do not take a consolation weapon mid-loop.

groups.activity: kill Thralls, reveal mods, and test the sequence

rows.label: revealed Requiems
rows.note: Murmurs reveal mods, not their order

conditions: Thralls on your Lich's influence nodes build Murmurs and rage. Squadmates' Thralls also give Murmurs, but do not raise your Lich's rage.
Once the first mod is revealed, stab whenever the Lich appears. A wrong attempt ranks it up but grants the squad 10 Murmurs and tests its position; skip only a first appearance with no revealed mod.
Use long Survival, Defense, Excavation, or Interception nodes for abundant Thralls, then fast missions when only rage is needed.
bonuses: A Requiem Ultimatum forces a confrontation. Palladino sells one weekly for 10 Riven Slivers; use it solo so it cannot summon a squadmate's adversary.

disclosures.title: use Oull to cap the guessing
disclosures.body: With one known mod, try Oull → mod 1 → random; Oull → mod 2 → mod 1; mod 1 → Oull → mod 2; then mod 2 → Oull → mod 1. This guarantees the kill by Lich level 4 in the worst case.

conditions: Choose Vanquish, never Convert. Conversion gives a tradeable Lich contract instead of the weapon.
The weapon bypasses its normal Mastery Rank 13 requirement when claimed from a Lich, but still needs its own weapon slot.
A vanquish has a 25% chance each to award Oull and a Requiem Ultimatum.
bonuses: The Nukor arrives built; no crafting materials or Foundry timer are needed.

rows.label: 60% Magnetic bonus
rows.alt: stop at the first usable roll

conditions: Valence Fusion uses the higher bonus × 1.1, capped at 60%. Results at 58% or higher round to 60%; a displayed 53% roll guarantees 60% on one more fusion.
Keep copies and fuse every donor into the highest roll. Fusing low rolls together early wastes progress if a later copy beats them.
Start fusion from the Nukor you want to keep. Catalysts, Forma, Exilus adapters, Focus lenses, and Elemental Vice on the donor are destroyed.
Elemental Vice enables free element swapping for this weapon after rank 40. Buy it from Eleanor at Hex rank 5 for 50,000 standing or from the Market for 20 platinum.
bonuses: Only one copy needs Magnetic because Valence Fusion lets you select the surviving element; Elemental Vice later makes swaps free.

disclosures.title: the 60% chase is optional
disclosures.body: A 60% Nukor is a multi-Lich project. Secure a usable Magnetic copy first, then keep high rolls and make fusions only when their donor cannot beat the copy you are keeping.
